section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Subjective Happiness Scale (SHS), a 4-item molar measure used to assess the extent to which individuals believe they are happy or unhappy. The SHS uses 7-point rating scales and demonstrates adequate internal consistency and good construct validity in its Malay translation. The study reports omega reliability of .80 (95% CI = .75-.85) for SHS scores.
